answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nadir of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. Every claim climbs the wander of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the willow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
